verdict.rationale: Fleet monitoring is a fair question for a robotics software platform, but the evidence pack shows no fleet-management dashboard for health, location, or status across many robots. The only related material is general-purpose building blocks: topics that can carry robot status, CLI introspection of a single ROS graph, topic statistics, and RViz in the desktop install. An ops team would have to build the fleet dashboard themselves, so this is not counted as delivering the story.
